verdict.rationale: Angular's own docs state that apps are 'organized yet modular thanks to Angular components and dependency injection'. Community users back the modular half, reporting reusable, encapsulated components in production apps. DI is praised for easing testing, though only in the AngularJS era, and one long-time user says the provider system is poorly documented; that is a documentation complaint, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the DI/provider system and module organization, and hands-on corroboration of DI in modern Angular.
